subject: Mutual action plan: onboarding & evaluation timeline for Solstice Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan starter — Solstice evaluation & timeline

Hi Lena — great to meet you over email. Thanks again for the time earlier today. Per our conversation I wanted to introduce Naomi (your CSM) and Marissa (who will help on success criteria) and propose a first-pass mutual action plan to align on goals, owners, and a target close.

Attached: Solstice_MAP_template.xlsx (lightweight workbook we use to track milestones).

High level ask from Redwood: confirm the internal stakeholders below, the three evaluation objectives we discussed, and whether the 8-week evaluation window (target: Jul 1 go/no-go) still works for your team.

Suggested owners (please confirm):
- Customer champion: Lena Ortiz (your team)
- Evaluation owner (day-to-day): Raj Patel (data & integration)
- Redwood AE: Karthik Iyer
- Redwood CSM: Naomi Feldman

Suggested 8-week cadence (example):
Week 0: Data access & test dataset handoff
Week 1–2: Integration + baseline tests
Week 3–4: Full eval scenarios + quality checks
Week 5: Performance tuning and quantization recommendations
Week 6–7: Regression checks and business KPI measurement
Week 8: Executive review & go/no-go decision

Success criteria (draft):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for target flows
- Accuracy: F1 ≥ 0.85 on curated evaluation set
- Cost: average per-inference cost under $0.015 after batching/caching

Next steps: can you confirm the stakeholder list and the suggested owners by EOD Wednesday? If that works, Naomi will send a populated MAP and a calendar invite for an initial 30-min alignment call.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Solstice_MAP_template.xlsx
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@solsticehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@solsticehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan starter — Solstice evaluation & timeline

Thanks, Karthik — and thanks for the clear outline. Quick confirmations from our side:

Stakeholders:
- Champion / exec sponsor: Lena Ortiz (Clinical Ops)
- Evaluation lead: Raj Patel (Data Engineering) — he will own test data and API access
- Procurement: purchasing@solsticehealth.com (copied here)

The 8-week window to target Jul 1 for a go/no-go looks reasonable, but procurement will need a SOW and data handling appendix to start their review (likely a 2–3 week lead).

Two clarifying Qs:
1) For the evaluation success criteria — can you confirm whether the cost target assumes a 75% average batch utilization? We need that because our production profile currently has many short, low-batch requests.
2) For test data — Raj is working on a sanitized dataset. Is a CSV + small sample payload set sufficient for Week 0?

Happy to confirm owners — Raj will coordinate access next Tuesday. Procurement (purchasing@solsticehealth.com) will reach out separately for SOW and security addenda.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Clinical Operations
Solstice Health

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan starter — Solstice evaluation & timeline (populating next steps)

Thanks Lena — copying the MAP populated with owners and a short evaluation plan (attached). Quick replies inline: 

- Cost target: the $0.015 per-inference target was modeled at ~70–80% batch utilization. Naomi will work with Raj during Weeks 1–2 to capture realistic batching patterns; if your request sizes skew small we can recommend SDK-level batching or a small proxy cache to bring unit cost down.

- Test data format: CSV plus a 50-sample JSON payload set is perfect for Week 0. If you can share the sample by next Tuesday (May 18) Raj and we will schedule the integration window.

Populated timeline (high level):
- May 18: Redacted dataset + sample payloads delivered by Solstice
- May 19–25: Integration & baseline tests (Redwood infra + data validation)
- May 26–June 9: Scenario evaluations & quality measurement windows
- June 10–16: Optimization and tuning (model variant + quantization recommendations)
- June 17–23: Regression & business KPI validation
- June 24–30: Executive review prep & procurement finalization
- Jul 1: Go/no-go review

Action items assigned (please confirm):
- Raj: deliver dataset + API credentials (Due: May 18)
- Lena: executive availability for Jul 1 decision (Due: Jun 15)
- Karthik: coordinate SOW and procurement materials (Due: May 14)
- Naomi: send calendar invites for weekly syncs and upload MAP to Drive (Due: May 13)

Attached: evaluation-scenarios.pdf (detailed example tests). Naomi will also drop the shared MAP workbook in Drive and link it in the calendar invite.

If that all looks good I will put the first 30-min sync on calendar for May 19 to triage any integration questions.

Thanks — Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 646-555-0224

Attachments: evaluation-scenarios.pdf
